title: To create caring, responsible and dynamic global citizens of tomorrow
lead: Committed to the development of the nation, and to the growth of every individual child within it.
motto: Develop a passion for learning, and you will always grow.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.statement: To transform education by creating inclusive, forward-thinking and compassionate future citizens.
paragraphs: Inclusive, because a school that only works for the confident child is not doing its job. Forward-thinking, because the world our students will work in is not the one we were trained for. Compassionate, because ability without decency has never yet improved a community.
We hold the three together deliberately. Any one of them alone produces something we would not want to send out into the world.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.statement: To build a foundation of lifelong learning through a balanced curriculum and a commitment to individual growth and community.
paragraphs: A balanced curriculum means academics, the arts, sport and service given real time in the week — not the first three squeezed to make room for examinations.

A commitment to individual growth means a teacher is expected to know where each child is, not only where the class is. And community means the school is answerable to the families and the neighbourhood around it.

philosophy.title: Our Educational Philosophy
paragraphs: Apostolic believes that every student is an individual with a unique personality. The school therefore offers an education that weaves academic and artistic excellence together with social engagement and moral awareness.

We work with educational principles that encourage imagination, flexibility in thinking and a genuine love of learning. Questions and challenges are introduced progressively and at the right age, so that initiative and self-direction grow as the child does rather than being demanded all at once.
The result we are aiming for is a young adult dedicated to the pursuit of ongoing learning and eager to contribute positively to the global society of the twenty-first century.

values.title: Individuality
values.description: Every student is treated as a person with a distinct temperament, pace and set of gifts.

values.title: Creativity
values.description: Imagination and flexible thinking are taught, practised and assessed — not merely admired.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: New methods are welcome in our classrooms when they demonstrably help children learn.

values.title: Compassion
values.description: Our motto is a working instruction: love thy neighbour as thyself.

values.title: Responsibility
values.description: Students are given real duties — to their class, their team, their campus and their city.

values.title: Perseverance
values.description: Effort is recognised as clearly as attainment, because effort is the part a child controls.
